events.text: {"verdict":"resolve","decision":"Don't wait on Adi; the admin API does this, and it is not a database edit. 1) Authenticate to the live centre with the owner key in ~/.config/tantra/revops-admin-key, using the auth flow in cloud/src/index.ts. Never print the key. 2) PATCH /admin/api/attendees/60 {revoked:false,test:true}. Then GET /admin/api/attendees/60 and take the token from `attendee.link`. 3) Enter as attendee 60, build its funnel, and run test-run once. Log the screenshot result at 375, 768 and 1280, and utm_source per channel. If Browser Rendering is unavailable, log it as skipped; buy nothing. 4) Fix any failure. Deploy the centre from a clean detached worktree of origin/main so the parser fix 8144b57 goes live. 5) Delete only the tagged test contacts this run created, then PATCH attendee 60 back to {revoked:true}. 6) Clear 'Asked of Adi', log the Worker version and results, and set status to review.","why":"cloud/src/index.ts:642-656 has an admin PATCH that accepts revoked and test; the GET at :640 returns the enter link. T-229 decisions (2026-10-09, 2026-10-11) already approved admin-key PATCHes. T-061 revoked its own test attendees. orchestrator-autonomy: no asks for agent-doable steps.","outward_ok":["PATCH https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev/admin/api/attendees/60 {revoked:false,test:true} via the owner key in ~/.config/tantra/revops-admin-key, then {revoked:true} after the run","GET https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev/admin/api/attendees/60 to read test attendee 60's enter link","One funnel build and one test-run on https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev as test attendee 60 ([email], 'Adi test'), registering one tagged test contact per channel","Delete only the tagged test contacts created by this test-run","wrangler deploy of the revops-centre Worker from a clean detached worktree of origin/main (includes 8144b57)","git push origin main for tantra-redesign (fast-forward, no force) if the live run needs a fix commit","Read-only GET calls to Tantra and Metricool APIs with existing stored keys"],"reassign_to_claude":true,"adi_input":null}
